games.name: [RANKED] Inazuma Strikers
games.desc:
Inazuma Strikers is a football RPG experience inspired by the legendary anime Inazuma Eleven.

🔥 Train your player, level up, improve your stats, unlock powerful Hissatsu Techniques, and compete against other players to become the greatest player  in Inazuma!

❤️ This game was created by passionate Inazuma Eleven fans as a tribute to the series. While inspired by the anime, it is an original fan-made experience built to share our love for the franchise with the community.

🎮 Controls
🖱 Left Click – Shoot
🖱 Right Click – Pass
H - Header
Q – Dribble
F – Slide Tackle
E – Rainbow Flick
Z – Standing Tackle 

⚽ Step onto the pitch, master your skills, build your dream player, and become a true football legend!
